records.name: Elgin Cathedral
records.description: Ruined medieval cathedral known as the Lantern of the North and the dominant historic site in Elgin.

records.name: Elgin Museum
records.description: Scotland's oldest independent museum, strong on archaeology, natural history and Moray heritage.

records.name: Spynie Palace
records.description: Former bishop's palace with a massive tower and links to the medieval power of Moray.

records.name: Pluscarden Abbey
records.description: Working Benedictine abbey in a secluded glen, valued for tranquillity and architecture.

records.name: Johnstons of Elgin
records.description: Historic mill and visitor-friendly flagship linked to Elgin's cashmere and textile reputation.

records.name: Glen Moray Distillery
records.description: Classic riverside Speyside distillery close to the centre of Elgin.

records.name: Cooper Park
records.description: Popular town park with pond, open lawns and a relaxed family atmosphere.

records.name: Biblical Garden Elgin
records.description: Peaceful small garden themed around plants and stories from the Bible.

records.name: Lady Hill
records.description: Historic mound above the town providing a sense of Elgin's older defensive landscape.

records.name: Duke of Gordon Monument
records.description: Tall hilltop monument and a familiar feature of the Elgin skyline.

records.name: St Giles Church
records.description: Historic parish church standing close to the commercial heart of Elgin.

records.name: Elgin Town Hall
records.description: Important civic building used for events and cultural life in the centre of town.

records.name: Elgin High Street
records.description: Historic main street where Elgin's civic, shopping and everyday town life meets.

records.name: Thunderton House
records.description: 16th-century house offering a rare survival from pre-modern Elgin.

records.name: Duffus Castle
records.description: Picturesque earthwork and stone ruin north of Elgin with strong medieval atmosphere.

records.name: Covesea Lighthouse
records.description: Landmark Moray coast lighthouse with broad sea views and cliff scenery.

records.name: Lossiemouth East Beach
records.description: Long sandy beach on the Moray Firth, easily visited from Elgin.

records.name: Hopeman East Beach
records.description: Attractive beach beside a compact coastal village and harbour.

records.name: Burghead Fort
records.description: Headland fort site with Pictish and later defensive importance on the Moray coast.

records.name: Gordon Castle
records.description: Important estate house and landscape on the River Spey, reached easily from Elgin.

records.name: Gordon Castle Walled Garden
records.description: Beautifully restored productive walled garden within the Gordon Castle estate.

records.name: Benromach Distillery
records.description: Respected small distillery with a traditional style and accessible tours from Elgin.

records.name: Dallas Dhu Historic Distillery
records.description: Preserved distillery site that shows how whisky was once made in Speyside.

records.name: Nelson Tower
records.description: Hilltop tower and viewpoint overlooking Forres and the Moray coastal plain.

records.name: Sueno's Stone
records.description: Enormous Pictish cross-slab and one of the most remarkable early-medieval monuments in Scotland.

records.name: Brodie Castle
records.description: National Trust castle with notable interiors, gardens and estate grounds.

records.name: Findhorn Bay
records.description: Wide tidal bay prized for birdlife, open views and ever-changing coastal light.

records.name: Findhorn Foundation
records.description: Globally known intentional community and ecovillage on the Moray coast.

records.name: Kinloss Abbey
records.description: Ruins of a once-important Cistercian monastery near Findhorn and Forres.

records.name: Culbin Forest
records.description: Large coastal forest of tracks, dunes and wildlife-rich habitats west of Findhorn Bay.

records.name: Randolph's Leap
records.description: Dramatic gorge on the River Findhorn with a famous leap-of-legend viewpoint.

records.name: Cardhu Distillery
records.description: One of the best-known Speyside distilleries and an easy whisky detour from Elgin.

records.name: Aberlour Distillery
records.description: Well-known Speyside distillery in a handsome village setting on the Spey.

records.name: Speyside Cooperage
records.description: Excellent visitor centre showing the craft of barrel making central to whisky production.

records.name: Glen Grant Distillery
records.description: Historic Rothes distillery with beautiful Victorian gardens.

records.name: Macallan Estate
records.description: Modern whisky architecture and the long-established Macallan estate above the River Spey.

records.name: Tugnet Ice House
records.description: Rare industrial heritage structure from the salmon-fishing economy at the mouth of the Spey.

records.name: Spey Bay
records.description: Shingle coast and river-mouth landscape renowned for birds, dolphins and big open skies.

records.name: Plainstones, Elgin
records.description: Historic market space in central Elgin where several of the town's old routes converge.

records.name: Linkwood Distillery
records.description: Historic Elgin distillery whose name is deeply woven into the town's whisky identity.
